description: AI Voiceover for Existing Videos — machine-readable feature list derived from plan.md Todos, with user-approved SRT workflow F14 and embedded subtitle track F15 extensions.

status_rules.in_progress: Being worked on right now. Only one feature should be in_progress at a time.
status_rules.implemented: Code written, but verification NOT yet executed. This is NOT a completed state.
status_rules.verified: ALL verification[].command entries have been ACTUALLY EXECUTED and passed, with evidence recorded in agent-progress.md. Only this state counts as done.
status_rules.blocked: WANTS to proceed but CANNOT, due to an external obstacle (missing environment, missing agent capability, unmet dependency). blocked_reason must be filled in. An agent may set this state on its own judgement.
status_rules.deferred: DELIBERATELY put on hold by a scope/priority decision - not obstructed. deferred_reason must be filled in. ONLY the user may decide to defer a feature; an agent MUST NOT set this state on its own to avoid implementing or verifying work. To resume, the user moves it back to pending.

hard_rule: A feature MUST NOT be set to 'verified' merely because source files exist or because the code looks correct. Verification commands must be actually run, and their output recorded in agent-progress.md with a timestamp. An agent MUST NOT use 'deferred' as an escape hatch for work it finds difficult - use 'blocked' (with blocked_reason) or 'implemented' instead.

verification_types.command: Automated: a shell command whose exit code 0 means pass.
verification_types.manual: Human/agent-observed check with an explicit pass condition. Requires evidence note in agent-progress.md.
